report: Revision Kohn-Sham Rust solver: checks of the canonical matrix (SPEC section 7)

checks.name: theory_input_metric_forms
checks.detail: ks-theory.json (sha256 34f7fa2a4543fd91) states the forms of the corrected metric of 2026-10-16 that the solver implements: chi' = f N chi in real form with the hidden scale f = e^(-a4) b4^(1/2) (model.rs Physics::fh, shoot.rs), kappa = e^(-a4) constant in y, P = e^(-3Hy)/Vol_7 with Vol_7 = ell^3 v_t e^((2 beta - 1) a4,0) (scf.rs, model.rs), the y-conservation p0' + 3H (p0 - p_t) = 0 and the history identity dE/da4 = -3 P3 - 3 (beta/2 - 1) P_t - (beta/2 - 1) P0 (analysis.rs), the fold-band slope c = e^(-a4,0) (spectrum.rs; c(a4,0 = 0) = 1); entries not matching: none

checks.name: theory_input_coefficients
checks.detail: ks-theory.json (sha256 34f7fa2a4543fd91): M_eff = m + 0.9375 lambda S, v_v = -0.0625 lambda n, e_x = (-0.03125 n^2 + -0.03125 S^2) lambda; consistent: M_eff - m = d e_int/dS with e_int = (1/2 + -0.03125) lambda S^2 + -0.03125 lambda n^2, v_v = d e_int/dn

checks.name: gamma_fixture_numeric
checks.detail: gammas.json (sha256 c99277bab4793c42): {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 eta^ab exactly in floating point (max deviation 0e0), C = g0 g1 g2 g3 and B = -i C g4 reproduced (max deviation 0e0)

checks.name: block_reduction_numeric
checks.detail: basis V of ks-theory.json (rows = spinor components): |V^dag V - 1| = 1.1e-16; off-block entries of V^dag X V 2.8e-17; diagonal blocks equal the solver's forms (i g4 g0 -> -i j sigma1, -i g4 -> j sigma2, -g4 g1 -> j sigma3, B B -> 1, B C -> j sigma2, B B g0 -> sigma3, -i B C g1 -> j sigma3, g0 -> sigma3, B -> j s2) to 1.1e-16: the 2x2 equation h_j = j[-(i/f) sigma1 d_y + M sigma2 + kappa k sigma3] + v integrated by the solver is the 16-component Hamiltonian (the scalar 1/f multiplies the d_y term in both)

checks.name: free_k0_analytic_spectra
checks.detail: k = 0, constant M, v = 0, theta_tip = 0 (ks-theory.json boundaryConditions.exactK0Spectra) for (m, L, a4,0) = (1, 3, 0), (1, 2, 0), (2, 3, 0) (f = 1) and (1, 3, 1.5) (f = e^(-1/2) on the history), labels -3..5 of both fold conditions: even eps = 0 and +-sqrt(M^2 + (n pi/(f L))^2), odd eps = +-sqrt(M^2 + p^2) with tan(p f L) = -p/M; max |difference| 7.23e-10 for |eps| < 4 m (tolerance 5e-9, RK4 error ~ (f h eps)^4), 5.05e-8 for |eps| >= 4 m (tolerance 3e-7)

checks.name: free_zero_mode_exact
checks.detail: k = 0 fold zero mode (both j) at a4,0 = 0 (f = 1) and a4,0 = 2 (f = e^(-2/3)): eps = 0 exactly (max |eps| = 0e0), chi = (a, 0) with b = 0 identically (max |b| = 0e0); a = sqrt(2fM/(1 - e^(-2fML))) e^(fMy) to 1.35e-12 (normalised in int dy, Simpson)
